preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the binary strings S and P must be between 3 and 1000.
The lengths of S and P must be equal to N.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(c in S for c in '01') and any(c in P for c in '01')
postconditions.description: Both S and P must contain at least one '0' and one '1' to allow conversion.

postconditions.expression: S == P or (any(c in S for c in '01') and any(c in P for c in '01'))
postconditions.description: If S is already equal to P, output 'YES'; otherwise, check if conversion is possible based on the presence of '0' and '1'.
